skill.name: gpt-image-edit
skill.description: Uses RunComfy CLI to edit existing images with OpenAI GPT Image 2, with prompt guidance for preservation, text replacement, layout changes, and multi-reference edits.
skill.summary: Run targeted image edits through GPT Image 2 on RunComfy.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection or malicious hidden behavior was found in SKILL.md. Most static findings are Markdown formatting, placeholder URLs, documentation links, or disclosed token storage. Confirmed risks are the intended RunComfy CLI execution path and the disclosed outbound RunComfy model API dependency.

remediation.issue: External CLI commands are central to the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running install, login, or runcomfy run commands, and keep command arguments fixed.

remediation.issue: Image URLs and prompts are processed by a remote service.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear consent language before submitting sensitive images, private URLs, or client creative content to RunComfy.

remediation.issue: Credential setup depends on local RunComfy authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Continue documenting token storage, recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for automation, and warn users not to paste tokens into prompts.

content.value_statement: Image edits often drift from the source asset or change text incorrectly. This skill gives RunComfy GPT Image 2 prompts for precise preservation, localization, and composition.
actual_capabilities: Runs RunComfy GPT Image 2 edit examples through the local CLI.
Structures prompts for identity, layout, brand, and background preservation.
Supports multilingual in-image text replacement with quoted target text.
Explains multi-reference image composition with numbered image inputs.
Documents endpoint fields, size options, exit codes, and troubleshooting links.
limitations: Requires RunComfy CLI, an account, and either login or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.
Sends prompts and image URLs to RunComfy model infrastructure.
Uses publicly fetchable HTTPS image URLs, not private local files.
Long compound edits can drift and should be split into separate passes.

use_cases.title: Localize Ad Creative
use_cases.description: Replace headlines or CTA text while preserving layout, brand marks, and photography.

use_cases.title: Compose Product Scenes
use_cases.description: Combine a product subject with a reference room or background while matching lighting.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Variants
use_cases.description: Create controlled visual edits with documented parameters for review workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Background Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep the subject, pose, face, and brand marks unchanged. Replace the background with a clean studio sweep and soft floor shadow.

prompt_templates.title: Localized Headline Swap
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep the photo, layout, lighting, and logo unchanged. Replace only the headline with "OPEN TODAY" in the same position and weight.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Reference Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image 1 for the subject and image 2 for the room. Match image 2 lighting while keeping image 1 identity unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Staged Brand Revision
prompt_templates.prompt: First preserve identity, product shape, layout, and camera angle. Change only the CTA area, then return one edited asset for review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review workflow for branded assets.

output_examples.input: A portrait needs a warmer studio background while keeping the face and clothing unchanged.
output_examples.output: A RunComfy-ready edit plan emphasizing face, pose, clothing, and brand preservation before the background change.

output_examples.input: A poster headline must be converted to Japanese without moving the layout.
output_examples.output: A localized edit prompt that quotes the target text, names the Japanese script, and preserves the original typography placement.

output_examples.input: A product should appear in a kitchen from a second reference image.
output_examples.output: A multi-reference prompt that assigns subject, room, lighting, and color roles by image number.

best_practices: State what must stay unchanged before describing the edit.
Quote replacement text exactly and identify the script when editing in-image text.
Use size auto unless the edit changes the final framing.
anti_patterns: Combining many unrelated edits in one prompt.
Sending sensitive images or private URLs without user approval.
Assuming local files will work when the endpoint expects public HTTPS image URLs.

faq.question: Does this skill edit local image files?
faq.answer: No. The endpoint expects publicly fetchable HTTPS image URLs, so local files must be hosted first.

faq.question: Does it require RunComfy credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs the RunComfy CLI and either a browser login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN value.

faq.question: Can it preserve a person's identity?
faq.answer: It is designed for preservation prompts, but results still need human review before production use.

faq.question: Can it replace text inside images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill recommends quoting the exact replacement text and naming the writing system.

faq.question: How many reference images can it use?
faq.answer: The documented schema supports up to 10 image URLs, with the first image treated as primary.

faq.question: What should users review before running it?
faq.answer: Users should review the command, output directory, image URLs, and any sensitive prompt content.
